item.title: President appoints 2 Judicial Officers as Additional Judges of Punjab and Haryana High Court
item.description: The Collegium in December 2025 had approved the proposal to appoint Ramesh Chander Dimri and Neerja Kulwant Kalson as Additional Judges. The post President appoints 2 Judicial Officers as Additional Judges of Punjab and Haryana High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Kerala HC grants conditional bail to Film Director in casting couch allegations as investigation already crossed crucial stage
item.description: “Prima facie case of ‘casting couch’ practices, which must be dealt with a heavy hand. item.description: “Once the resolution plan had reduced the claim under the arbitral award to Re.1, the withdrawn amount could not continue to remain with the award-holder.” The post Custodia legis principle applied: Bombay HC directs return of withdrawn arbitral deposit after insolvency resolution appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Deliberate Entering of higher marks in recruitment forms cannot be regularised under guise of ‘human error’: Allahabad High Court
item.description: “Where an applicant manipulates higher marks to obtain an undeserved advantage, the appointment becomes tainted from its inception.” The post Deliberate Entering of higher marks in recruitment forms cannot be regularised under guise of ‘human error’: Allahabad High Court appeared first on SCC Times.
